mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 2.0% during a tightening cycle compresses discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces non-negative 20d returns in >60% of tightening cycles, or t-test p-value >0.05 for returns vs. baseline in such periods.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected surge in the unemployment rate above 4.0% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as market anticipates economic contraction.
failure_condition: SPX returns remain non-negative when UNRATE crosses above 4.0%, or p-value >0.05 in a t-test comparing triggered vs. non-triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: Continued growth in the INDPRO index above its current level signals robust supply-side expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO rises but SPX returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) over 2-year rolling windows, or Rank IC <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent quarterly demand growth (GDPC1) and monthly demand (HOUST) both rising over the horizon amplify investor confidence, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 and HOUST rise but SPX returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05), or interaction effect rank IC <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate transitions from below to above 3.5% during a labor market expansion, the subsequent rise in unemployment triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE crosses above 3.5% in expansion periods, or p-value >0.05 in t-test.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below recent levels during the next 5 trading days reduces discount rates, fostering positive S&P 500 forward returns over the short-term horizon.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS declines but SPX returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) over 1-year rolling windows, or Rank IC <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly demand increase (GDPC1) above 18,000 billions of chained 2017 dollars over the next 60 trading days signals robust economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 crosses above 18,000.0 in the next 60 trading days
failure_condition: GDPC1 crosses above 18,000 but SPX returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) over 2-year windows, or Rank IC <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly supply contraction (INDPRO index below 105.0) over the next 60 trading days indicates weakening production capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO crosses below 105.0 in the next 60 trading days
failure_condition: INDPRO falls below 105.0 but SPX returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) over 2-year windows, or Rank IC <0.03.
